scopeAudit.boundary: This sidecar covers only strict accepted COL26.8 species descending from the exact Amoebozoa root 622B2. ITIS 2026-08-26 has no exact Amoebozoa root; narrower or broader ITIS roots are intentionally not substituted.

rootBoundaryAudit.decision: No exact ITIS Amoebozoa root exists in the pinned export. No Amoebida, Rhizopoda, Protozoa or other nearby root is used as a taxon substitute.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: Unavailable: the pinned ITIS export has no exact Amoebozoa root from which to derive a current-species partition.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: Unavailable: no exact ITIS Amoebozoa root exists in this release.
statuses.ambiguous: Unavailable: no exact ITIS Amoebozoa root exists in this release.
statuses.unmatched: The exact COL Amoebozoa name has no candidate in the empty exact ITIS Amoebozoa index.

matchingContract.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered, package-wide or taxon-substituted matching is used.

deliveryContract.pagesLight: Pages needs only this small descriptor and may omit all row-level JSONL gzip shards.
deliveryContract.androidIosFull: Android and iOS complete-data inventories must include the descriptor and every listed row-level shard as the same checksum-addressed bytes.
deliveryContract.runtimeChange: This import deliberately changes no formal runtime or published release manifest.

generatedBy.deterministic: Pinned input checksums, exact COL and ITIS root audits, representation-only normalization, code-unit ID ordering and deterministic gzip; no wall-clock fields or fuzzy matching.
